findings: PS5 payload SDK maps __dlopen/__dlsym to a generated table of statically linked core libraries. Arbitrary ELF/JNI loading is unsupported, so libjvm.so cannot be dlopen'd at runtime.

The Java 25 runtime ships as bundled app content: assets/java25/lib/modules image plus lib/*.so. A title reads lib/modules via fopen and links JNI_CreateJavaVM at build time. This is the ProsperoCraft model and PS5Craft follows it.
PS5 title builds+signs into dist/PPSA90104/ (eboot.bin, sce_sys/param.json, sce_module/libc.prx).
elfldr at 192.168.2.15:9021 loaded the title ELF with no error. Console stdout goes to klog (not visible here).
FTP 2121 (ftpsrv.elf) is now consistently read-only on PASV; install via FTP unreliable on this console. Title folder ready for normal homebrew install.
HTTP API (libmicrohttpd) + dashboard validated end-to-end on host: GET /api/instances, POST start/stop/restart, index.html.
Platform shims added for libmicrohttpd: pipe2, tsearch/tfind/tdelete/twalk, gmtime_r, _Unwind_RaiseException/_Unwind_DeleteException stubs.
PS5_VulkanTemplate needs a pinned PS5_PayloadSDK fork (ps5platform) and a PS5_Vulkan RADV archive; neither is present here.
libmicrohttpd.a needs pipe2/tsearch which PS5 libc lacks; platform shims added. gmtime_r + _Unwind shims added.
